observer_source_assessment.root_only: Actual anchor.guard checks owning environment and unchanged owner/deadline/context/policy; no subagent override or entry execution here.

Query commands only hostname and nvidia-smi UUID/util/memory/compute-PID, no model/train/data/checkpoint, signals, flock deletion, install or remote file write.

observer_source_assessment.semantics: Proof scope binds both current source candidates, actual owner/context/SERVERS/allowed0,1/max1 and raw query SHA. Both known original PIDs must occur on their pinned cards, busy[0,1]/idle[] must be actual recomputed state. Availability change fails without a new launch or fake busy statement.

observer_source_assessment.scope_limit: NVML PID membership is an occupation observation, not a new process-owner/start-ticks identity proof; original identity/source health uses the separately reviewed native progress evidence.
observer_source_assessment.execution_status: NOT_EXECUTED_BY_REVIEW; no current busy result is pre-signed.
